title.narrative: Sustainable, inclusive and responsible business practices promoted to improve productivity, trade development and innovation, working conditions and compliance, focusing on the poor, ethnic groups and women

description.narrative: The ILO’s plan for productivity ecosystems for decent work brings together various approaches of the ILO on enterprise level, sectoral and national levels with the aim to support the productivity growth in Viet Nam with a focus on supporting the SMEs in the wood processing and machinery sectors. Sustainable enterprises are productive enterprises with decent working conditions created for the workers. The plan builds partnerships to complement the available tools at ILO with the best existing productivity improvement solutions on the market through implementation agreements and contracts with business associations in both target sectors and market-led business supporting organizations. The partnerships aim at piloting the workable approaches at SME and sectoral levels for digitalization, greenhouse gas inventory and emissions reduction, and middle manager skills improvement and at generating lessons for anchoring and upscaling of the approaches as sustainability options. In addition, with support from the ILO, Viet Nam participates actively in efforts to strengthen the social and solidarity economy (SSE) in Asia.
